# Hydrakin
Hydrakins are a species defined by their cybernetics and their body's ability to benefit off of normally dangerous gases.
## Unique Abilities
### Thermal Regulation
- Hydrakin bodies are [color=#FFA500]constantly heating up[/color]. As a result, they may have to manually radiate the heat out of their bodies. - They can tolerate heat without any insulation, but wearing hardsuits or coats will quickly start [color=#FFA500]heating them up[/color]. - Leporazine has an [color=#4169E1]amplified[/color] cooling effect on their body. - Their passive heat generation weakens in critical condition and stops entirely once they are dead.
### Atmospheric Adaptation
- Hydrakins are capable of breathing almost all gases. Carbon dioxide is the exception: it won't harm them, but it won't keep them breathing either. - Unique gases (such as Plasma, Tritium, Frezon, Nitrium, Healium, BZ and Nitrous Oxide) have mostly [color=#4169E1]positive[/color] effects on them, described in the "Chemicals" guidebook entry.
## Diet
- Hydrakins mostly prefer raw food. - They will get [color=#FFA500]poisoned[/color] by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- They are [color=#1e90ff]10% more resistant to blunt damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]completely immune to cold damage[/color]. - Unique gases often have a positive effect on Hydrakin biology.
## Drawbacks
- They take [color=#FFA500]15% more heat damage and 15% more slash damage[/color]. - Wearing glasses is [color=#FFA500]not possible[/color] due to the head anatomy.
